source_note: Short titles for common generic powertrain codes. These names follow the public SAE J2012 naming used across OBD-II references. This is not the SAE standard, not a complete catalog, and not evidence that a part has failed.
license_notes: Titles are factual code names restated for retrieval. Do not treat a title as a repair procedure.
